description: This file contains PHP classes and methods for database connection management, record handling, and result set processing using PEAR MDB2, specifically for the WACT_DB package within the revive-adserver project.

classes.name: MDB2Connection
classes.description: Encapsulates a database connection with lazy connection capability, error handling, and query execution methods.

classes.name: MDB2Record
classes.description: Represents a database record with methods for insert, update, and retrieving affected rows.

classes.name: MDB2RecordSet
classes.description: Handles result sets from database queries, supports iteration, paging, and total row count retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class with configuration or connection object.

methods.name: getConnectionId
methods.description: Returns the database connection object, establishing connection if necessary.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a database connection using singleton pattern.

methods.name: makeLiteral
methods.description: Converts PHP values into SQL literals based on type.

methods.name: NewRecordSet
methods.description: Creates a new MDB2RecordSet for executing queries.

methods.name: FindRecord
methods.description: Retrieves a single record based on a query.

methods.name: getOneValue
methods.description: Fetches a single value from a query.

methods.name: getOneColumnArray
methods.description: Fetches an array of first column values from a query.

methods.name: getTwoColumnArray
methods.description: Fetches an associative array from two columns of a query.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a SQL query that does not return a cursor.

methods.name: _execute
methods.description: Internal method to execute SQL and handle errors.
